txt: "Billie, Billie *Méjean*, you said? Give me a moment, I'll have to check our database." He puts down the receiver.
"Happy we could help. Good bye, officer." The librarian hangs up and the call gets redirected back to the station with a soft click...
"Happy we could help. Good bye, officer." The librarian hangs up and the call gets redirected back to the station.
"Here we go, sir: Rue de Saint-Ghislaine 33B, apartment no 20. It's in Martinaise, I believe... Capeside Apartments, it says. That's all."
"It says here that they returned their last book just a few days ago, but I wasn't at work that day."
"Marie knows Billie, she's been working here longer than me. Sometimes her husband returns some books for her."

"Marie?" He covers the phone with his hand and yells out into the room behind him: "Marie! Do you remember a reader named Billie Méjean? They returned a Thibault book the other day..." You hear someone answer from afar.
"Maybe you can write it down? It's Rue de Saint-Ghislaine 33B, apartment no 20. It's in Martinaise, I believe... Capeside Apartments, it says. That's all."
"She said it was an older man... And that she's pretty sure he had had a drink or two the last time she saw him."
"Sorry, Marie wasn't really paying any attention to that."
"Sorry, no -- Marie only knows him by sight."
"Uh, one second..." The librarian turns away from the phone again and relays the question.
"Yes, hello, are you still there?" You can hear him fiddle with the printout. "I found Billie Méjean's home address, is that alright? No phone number unfortunately."

"Yes, it was my colleague Marie," the librarian is speaking into the phone again. "She said that it was Billie's *husband* who returned the book. He also asked for this new sci-fi release "Loos, Radio City '87", but we don't have it yet."
"Yes, this is Central Jamrock Public Library here." A male librarian answers the call. "How can I help you, officer?"
